# Deck3 All-Forms Weakness Learning V2
Date: 2026-10-09. Status: ACTIVE EXECUTION STANDARD, not scientific validation or model retraining.
Precedence: canonical thesis authorities; corrected Dossiya Expert V2 (`.github/skills/dossiya-research-expert/references/DECK3_WEAKNESS_TO_VERIFIED_LEARNING_V2.md`); Deck3 global contract, mechanisms, exact palette, figure-only rule; this implementation contract. Earlier Deck3 cross-stage learning V1 files remain historical and are superseded by this correction.

## Source-provenance correction
A13 = `Pasted text(20261009-151339).txt`: prior-art table + M0/M1/M2 comparator; density and comparator-admission gaps.
B13 = `Pasted text (2)(20261009-151345).txt`: grid-side AC/DC accounting, heat balance, state equations and two sustainability pathways; exact physical boundary and service mapping gaps.
C13 = `Pasted text (3)(4).txt`: concise 13 slides but direct cross-state dependencies in candidate equations, insufficient AC quantification and citation artifacts.
Do not confuse these drafts with earlier seven/eight-slide versions.

## Invariant scope and evidence
Maintain distinct full P and T_e, extreme heat external forcing, thermal interdependencies only, physical state/time, electricity and mobility service resilience, two sustainability pathways and indicator-qualified SDG target relevance. Frozen approved GO/SO1–SO3 are source governance, NOT scientific validation; challenge scientific adequacy without silently changing official wording. All new mechanisms, data, numerical values, results and parameter choices require independent evidence.

## Error-to-correction contract
For every material issue: exact slide/claim, error, why it fails, retained strength, smallest scientifically admissible correction, evidence depth/source, positive and adversarial negative test, actual test output, remaining blocker and release status. NOT_RUN is not PASS. Never claim literature full-text inspection, successful model validation, native PowerPoint animation playback or effective image occupancy from creating a document.

## All-forms science gates
G01 Preserve scope while distinguishing frozen wording from physical truth.
G02 Identify actual physical components/control volumes, full systems versus active model.
G03 Independently qualify P→T_e and T_e→P, with AC-side port quantity/unit, real operating law or OPEN. An electrical arrow cannot certify thermal causality.
G04 Common external heat never proves cross-system propagation.
G05 Explicit AC/DC measurement boundary, sign, units, losses including auxiliaries, transient energy storage and potential V2G operating regime.
G06 Model only minimum sufficient admitted X(t), external H(t), physically defined algebraic interface Z(t), state→capability→actual transfer→service mapping; check dimensionality and initial conditions.
G07 Define observable critical crossing/event time, causal propagation and absent events (NOT_OBSERVED_IN_HORIZON); admit zero, one, two or inconclusive supported directions.
G08 Independent/static/dynamic M0/M1/M2 is optional candidate, never an imposed comparison; match heat forcing, controls, initial state and outputs before attributing effects.
G09 Closest prior art: exact study, access depth, governing laws, data, evidence, validation and claim-specific adjacent author-date citations. Novelty OPEN until supported.
G10 Verification, physical validation, uncertainty, sensitivity and identifiability are separate.
G11 Define electricity and mobility service Q(t), requirement/units; two sustainability paths, environmental/economic/social indicators, baseline, service unit, time horizon; SDG target links only with eligible measured indicators.
G12 One scientific main claim and up to three necessary points except exact objectives; no generic template heading, scraped favicon or duplicated image captions.
G13 Prefer where scientifically useful a **single visually unified AI-generated physical hardware scene plus accurate scientific diagram relations**: physically credible transformer, AC port, EVSE, vehicle, external heat and meaningful large arrows, with only short object-linked labels. Native/editable overlay layers when precision, accessibility or animation is needed. This user preference supersedes an overly rigid default of box-only native diagrams, but never forces AI imagery for RQs/equations/literature.
G14 Exact thirteen approved authored sRGB colors, white interiors, no explanatory image bands, no invented performance data, correct per-arrow object/quantity/evidence trace; raster-only art needs independent color/semantic/no-panel human review.
G15 Preserve exact native text, speaker notes and sources during assembly; a PNG cannot independently animate internal diagram components. Test actual PowerPoint playback before claiming animated. Use static fallback.

## Stage routing
- Text in chat: actually return text in chat, do not silently create PPTX.
- Stage 1: native editable title, claims, goals, notes/citations; no embedded figure; 13-slide current working structure unless user approves change.
- Stage 2: human-checked scientific brief BEFORE AI: selected equipment, interfaces, external heat, meaning of each arrow, one thesis takeaway, evidence status. AI draws real physics scene + diagram logic with minimal words; native labels/quantities can be overlaid. Reject imaginary heat through electric cables and unsupported symmetric arrows. Text-heavy evidence tables, RQs, methods, numerical plots remain native editable.
- Single-slide: preserve untouched slides and audit adjacent interpretation/citations.
- Engineering/scientific diagram and math: separate physical/electrical, thermal, sensor, control, simulated and assessment arrows. No invented equations/data, axes without units or fake empirical trends.
- Stage 3: figure-only review + mechanism-trace + text/notes/alt-color QA + meaningful visual area + actual render. Provisional review output allowed only with explicit non-certification.
- Animation: independently editable named components and connectors; prefer On Click persistent reveals if verified, else static/progressive fallback.
- QA/All: aggregate separate G01–G15 gates with PASS/FAIL/OPEN/NOT_RUN, evidence locator and remediation. Neither perfect aesthetics nor source consistency is laboratory validation.

## 20 adversarial cases (specifications, not executed tests)
A01 hot transformer without operating law does NOT imply charger outage.
A02 charger DC derating alone does NOT imply changed grid AC loading.
A03 shared heat causing two warm devices does NOT establish interdependency.
A04 one direction supported, other unsupported: use qualified one only.
A05 neither supported: report negative or inconclusive evidence without expanding scope.
A06 synthetic steady 55 kW AC, 50 kW DC, 1 kW auxiliaries: 5 kW non-DC difference includes auxiliary 1 + other 4, not extra 1.
A07 AC exporting V2G requires actual compatible hardware, signed conventions.
A08 no threshold crossing within horizon: censored/unobserved, no invented delay.
A09 direct cross-state term without physical law: candidate/remove.
A10 M0/M2 inputs differ: causal model comparison BLOCKED.
A11 numerically convergent/energy conserving code without observations: verified numerics only.
A12 only paper abstract inspected: do not quote inaccessible equations.
A13 fleet departure readiness differs from official SDG 9.1.2.
A14 frozen wording conflicts with new evidence: flag and propose authorized in-scope revision.
A15 AI image draws heat conducted along AC cord without admitted physics: reject.
A16 AI scene contains literature table or big explanatory bottom cards: reject.
A17 one raster scene with demand for independent arrow reveals: separate native layers or static fallback.
A18 PNG dimension/color syntax checks pass but no semantic visual inspection: no image approval.
A19 GO/SO copied perfectly yet asserts proven two-way thermal effects: fail scientific gate.
A20 PPTX renders but actual desktop playback untested: no animation certification.

## Release meanings
GOVERNANCE_CONFORMING; SCIENCE_CANDIDATE; IMAGE_PROVISIONAL; ASSET_INTEGRITY_ONLY; PPTX_RENDERED_REVIEWED; POWERPOINT_PLAYBACK_VERIFIED; PHYSICS_VALIDATED (requires real independent case validation). Never collapse statuses into a single PASS.
